title: Fire Wall Sorceress — complete beginner guide
desc: Skill tree, gear and leveling order all in one
summary: A fire Sorceress built around Fire Wall, with Fire Ball as backup. Fire Wall lays flames on the ground that burn monsters walking through, and putting points into Warmth and Inferno raises its damage.
statPriority: Strength only for gear requirements, Dexterity only enough to reach max block with your shield (0 if you don't block), everything else into Vitality. You don't need Energy — mana comes from gear and Warmth.

skillOrder.skill: Hunt with Fire Bolt, Warmth 1, Frozen Armor 1
Raise Fire Ball (prereq: Fire Bolt) + Inferno 1, Blaze 1 (Fire Wall prereq)
Keep raising Fire Ball, Telekinesis 1 → Teleport 1
Put points into Fire Wall first
Fire Wall 20 → Fire Mastery 20
Warmth · Inferno (Fire Wall synergies) → leftover points into Fire Ball

keyItems: Weapon & shield: Spirit (runeword) sword and shield — faster cast rate, mana, all skills
Helm: Harlequin Crest or a +Fire Skills circlet
Armor: Skin of the Vipermagi (faster cast rate, magic resist)
Gloves & belt: Magefist (faster cast rate, fire skills), Arachnid Mesh
Charms: +1 Fire Skills Grand Charm, life and resist Small Charms
levelingNotes: Normal is fast enough with Fire Bolt → Fire Ball alone.
Lay Fire Wall across the path monsters take so they get hit several times. Teleport away to gain distance and pull them over the wall.
Hell has fire immune monsters. Skip them, or deal with them using your mercenary or a second elemental skill.
Hitting the 63% and 105% cast rate breakpoints makes a big difference — check with the breakpoint calculator.
strengths: Area damage over time makes clearing packs fast
Low gear requirements make the early game easy
weaknesses: Weak against fire immune monsters
Dangerous when surrounded by melee monsters — Teleport is a must

title: Hammerdin stat and skill order
desc: From solo farming to party support — tree variants for each situation
summary: A Paladin who uses Blessed Hammer with the Concentration aura. Hammers deal magic damage, so few monsters resist them, and points in Vigor and Blessed Aim raise hammer damage.
statPriority: Strength only for gear requirements, Dexterity only enough to reach max block with your shield, the rest into Vitality. Mana comes from gear (mana and mana leech).

skillOrder.skill: Hunt in melee with Might and Zeal, Holy Bolt 1 (hammer prereq)
Blessed Hammer 1, Blessed Aim 1 → Concentration 1
Blessed Hammer 20 first, then Concentration 20
Holy Shield 1 (prereq: Charge, Blessed Hammer)
Vigor 20 → Blessed Aim 20 (hammer synergy)

keyItems: Weapon: Heart of the Oak or a Spirit sword
Shield: Spirit paladin shield or Stormshield
Armor: Enigma (Teleport) — otherwise Skin of the Vipermagi
Helm: Harlequin Crest
Ring & amulet: The Stone of Jordan, Mara's Kaleidoscope
levelingNotes: Blessed Hammer spirals around the character, so dive in between the monsters.
It is magic damage, so only watch out for magic immune monsters.
Holy Shield greatly raises your block chance and defense.
Hitting the 75% and 125% cast rate breakpoints shortens the gap between hammers — check with the breakpoint calculator.
strengths: Magic damage means few immune monsters
Holy Shield gives high block and defense, so you are sturdy
weaknesses: The hammer path makes killing distant enemies slow
Heavy mana cost — you need mana gear

title: Whirlwind Barb vs Frenzy Barb — which one suits you?
desc: Whirlwind and Frenzy Barbarian compared, plus gear recommendations
summary: A Whirlwind Barbarian spins and slashes through enemies, while a Frenzy Barbarian dual wields and hammers away. Both can raise party life and mana with Battle Orders.
statPriority: Strength and Dexterity up to weapon requirements (Dexterity also helps attack rating), the rest into Vitality.

skillOrder.skill: Bash → Stun → Concentrate 1, Leap → Leap Attack 1 → Whirlwind 20 (from level 30)
Double Swing → Double Throw 1 → Frenzy 20 (from level 24)
Shout 1 → Battle Orders · Battle Command, focus on one weapon mastery, Increased Speed · Natural Resistance

keyItems: Whirlwind weapon: Grief (Phase Blade etc.)
Frenzy weapons: two one-handed weapons (e.g. two Grief)
Armor: Fortitude or Enigma
Helm: Arreat's Face
Swap weapon: Call to Arms — boosts Battle Orders and Battle Command levels
levelingNotes: Whirlwind needs level 30, so level with Bash and Double Swing until then.
Frenzy raises your movement and attack speed the more you hit enemies.
Swap to Call to Arms and use Battle Orders to greatly raise life and mana.
strengths: Fast melee kills
Can buff the party with Battle Orders
weaknesses: Few ways to deal with ranged enemies
Heavily weapon dependent

title: Bone Necro leveling route — Normal to Hell
desc: When to switch from Bone Spear to Bone Spirit
summary: A Necromancer who fights with Bone Spear and Bone Spirit. Teeth, Bone Wall and Bone Prison are synergies for Bone Spear and Bone Spirit, and bone skills deal magic damage, so immunities are rarely a problem.
statPriority: Strength only for gear requirements, Dexterity for blocking with a shield (optional), the rest into Vitality.

skillOrder.skill: Hunt with Teeth, Amplify Damage 1, Bone Armor 1, Corpse Explosion 1
Raise Bone Spear (prereq: Corpse Explosion)
Bone Spirit (prereq: Bone Spear)
Bone Spear · Bone Spirit 20 → Teeth · Bone Wall · Bone Prison (synergies)

keyItems: Weapon: a wand with bone skills or Wizardspike
Shield: Homunculus or a Necromancer shield with +Bone Skills
Helm: Harlequin Crest
Armor: Enigma or Skin of the Vipermagi
levelingNotes: Early in Normal, it is fine to let Raise Skeleton hold the line in front of you.
Bone Spear pierces in a straight line, so line monsters up and fire.
Bone Spirit chases enemies and hits them, which makes it good against bosses and single targets.
strengths: Magic damage means few immune monsters
Bone Prison and Bone Wall block paths, so you stay safe
weaknesses: Slow against wide, scattered packs
Heavy mana cost — you need mana gear

title: Multishot Bowazon — ranged area farming
desc: A bow build that sweeps corridors with a fan of arrows
summary: A bow Amazon who clears packs with Multiple Shot and kills bosses with Guided Arrow. Critical Strike, Penetrate and Pierce make up for damage and attack rating.
statPriority: Strength only for gear requirements, mostly Dexterity (bow damage and attack rating), the rest into Vitality.

skillOrder.skill: Hunt with Magic Arrow and Cold Arrow, Multiple Shot (from level 6)
Guided Arrow (prereq: Cold Arrow, Multiple Shot), Critical Strike · Penetrate
Valkyrie 1 (prereq: Decoy, Evade), Pierce
Multiple Shot · Guided Arrow 20 → Critical Strike · Penetrate

keyItems: Bow: Windforce or Lycander's Aim (Buriza-Do Kyanon for a crossbow)
Helm: Harlequin Crest
Armor: Enigma or Fortitude
Gloves & belt: increased attack speed (IAS) stats
levelingNotes: Level early on with Magic Arrow so you never worry about mana.
Switching between Multiple Shot for packs and Guided Arrow for bosses is the efficient way to play.
Valkyrie holds the line in front of you, which makes survival much easier.
strengths: Attack from a safe distance
Handles both area and single target
weaknesses: Low survivability when enemies get close
Heavily bow gear dependent

title: Hurricane Wind Druid — sustained area damage
desc: An elemental Druid that fills the screen with Tornado and Hurricane
summary: An elemental Druid who uses Hurricane (cold) and Tornado (physical) together. Twister, Tornado and Hurricane synergize with each other, and Cyclone Armor absorbs elemental damage.
statPriority: Strength only for gear requirements, Dexterity for blocking with a shield (optional), the rest into Vitality.

skillOrder.skill: Hunt with Firestorm and Arctic Blast, Cyclone Armor 1
Twister 1
Tornado (prereq: Twister)
Hurricane 20 (prereq: Tornado)
Tornado 20 → Twister · Cyclone Armor (synergies), Oak Sage 1

keyItems: Weapon: Heart of the Oak or a weapon with +Elemental Skills
Helm: Jalal's Mane or a Druid helm with +Elemental Skills
Armor: Enigma or Skin of the Vipermagi
Ring: The Stone of Jordan
levelingNotes: Hurricane is a cold storm that circles the character, so you have to step in among the enemies — always keep Cyclone Armor on.
Handle cold immune monsters with Tornado (physical).
strengths: Two damage types (cold and physical) cover immunities
Cyclone Armor makes you resistant to elemental damage
weaknesses: Weak against monsters immune to both cold and physical
Heavy mana cost

title: Trapsin — wiping packs with Lightning Sentry
desc: A ranged, support-style build that deals damage safely with placed traps
summary: A trap Assassin who lays down Lightning Sentries and finishes with Death Sentry (corpse explosion). Shock Web and Charged Bolt Sentry are synergies for Lightning Sentry.
statPriority: Strength and Dexterity only for gear requirements, the rest into Vitality.

skillOrder.skill: Hunt mainly with Fire Blast
Charged Bolt Sentry, Shock Web
Lightning Sentry 20 (prereq: Charged Bolt Sentry)
Death Sentry (prereq: Lightning Sentry)
Shock Web · Charged Bolt Sentry (synergies), Fade · Shadow Master 1

keyItems: Weapon: an Assassin claw with trap skills
Helm: Harlequin Crest
Armor: Enigma or Skin of the Vipermagi
Shield: Stormshield or Spirit
Belt: Arachnid Mesh
levelingNotes: You can place up to 5 sentries at once — group them along the path monsters take.
Death Sentry needs a corpse to explode. Kill something with Lightning Sentry first, then place it.
Handle lightning immune monsters with Death Sentry or your mercenary.
strengths: Attack from a safe distance
Fast single target boss kills
weaknesses: Weak against lightning immune monsters
Not enough room to place sentries in tight spaces

title: Demon tree Summoner Warlock — new class starter guide
desc: A starter build for the new class, with Goatman, Tainted and Defiler up front and field demons bound as well
summary: The Warlock, a new class added with the "Reign of the Warlock" DLC, has three skill trees: Chaos, Eldritch and Demon. This guide is the basic Demon tree build: summons in front, with the Warlock's own tools — Bind Demon and Consume — for improvising mid-fight.
statPriority: Invest mainly in Vitality and add Strength only up to gear requirements. Early on, when you rely heavily on summons, survival comes first.

skillOrder.skill: Summon Goatman 20 (main summon)
Demonic Mastery 10 (2 summons) → 20 (3 summons). Demons absorbed with Consume count toward this number
Spread points across Summon Tainted and Summon Defiler (summon variety)
Death Mark, Bind Demon. 10 hard points can bind a Champion, 15 a Unique, 20 a Super Unique (3.2)
Finish with self-buff skills: Blood Oath · Engorge · Blood Boil · Consume

keyItems: Offhand: Grimoire (Warlock only) — to hold a two-handed weapon in one hand, you need a Grimoire in the other (3.2)
Armor: mostly maximum life and elemental resists
Ring & amulet: mana recovery and resists
Weapon: a dagger, or consider a runeword with Warlock skills
levelingNotes: The core of the Warlock is Bind Demon — you bind demon monsters in the field and borrow their abilities. Since 3.2, elite demons can only be bound if you have hard points in Bind Demon.
Absorbing a demon with Consume gives you a buff. Since 3.2, the higher the difficulty that demon came from, the bigger the bonus (Hell > Nightmare > Normal).
Since 3.2, life potions are 150% as effective, which makes early survival easier.
strengths: Play safely with summons up front
Bind and Consume let you adapt mid-fight
weaknesses: A learning curve before you get used to managing summons
Binding elite demons takes many points in Bind Demon

title: Blizzard Sorceress — the standard season starter
desc: A cold Sorceress that grows well on little gear, the safest pick for a season start
summary: A cold Sorceress who freezes and kills over a wide area with Blizzard, and uses Glacial Spike to freeze and hit between Blizzard cooldowns. Blizzard gets stronger the more points you put into Ice Bolt, Ice Blast and Glacial Spike.
statPriority: Strength only for gear requirements, Dexterity only enough to reach max block with your shield (0 if you don't block), the rest into Vitality. Mana comes from gear and mercenary auras.

skillOrder.skill: Hunt with Ice Bolt and Frost Nova, Frozen Armor 1, Static Field 1
Glacial Spike (prereq: Ice Blast), Telekinesis 1 → Teleport 1
Put points into Blizzard first (prereq: Frost Nova, Glacial Spike)
Blizzard 20 → Cold Mastery (lowers cold resistance of enemies that are not cold immune)
Glacial Spike 20 → Ice Blast · Ice Bolt (Blizzard synergies)

keyItems: Weapon & shield: Spirit (sword and shield) or Heart of the Oak
Helm: Harlequin Crest
Armor: Enigma or Skin of the Vipermagi (Stealth early on)
Gloves: Magefist
Belt: Arachnid Mesh
Amulet: Mara's Kaleidoscope
Ring: The Stone of Jordan
Mercenary: Act 2 mercenary + Insight (mana regeneration)
levelingNotes: Blizzard has a cooldown — freeze enemies with Glacial Spike in between so you aren't just standing there taking hits.
Deal with cold immune monsters using your mercenary or Static Field, or skip them.
Hitting the 63% and 105% cast rate breakpoints makes a big difference — check with the breakpoint calculator.
strengths: Strong on little gear, so great for a season start
Wide area attacks and freezing keep you safe
weaknesses: Weak against cold immune monsters
The Blizzard cooldown makes single targets slower

title: Lightning Sorceress — Terror Zone farming
desc: A lightning Sorceress that bounces Chain Lightning through packs of monsters
summary: A lightning Sorceress who uses Chain Lightning as the main attack and Lightning for single targets. Chain Lightning gets stronger the more points you put into Charged Bolt, Lightning and Nova, and it is more efficient the more monsters there are.
statPriority: Strength only for gear requirements, Dexterity only enough to reach max block with your shield (0 if you don't block), the rest into Vitality.

skillOrder.skill: Hunt with Charged Bolt, Static Field 1, Frozen Armor 1
Lightning (prereq: Charged Bolt), Nova 1 (prereq: Static Field)
Put points into Chain Lightning first (prereq: Lightning), Telekinesis 1 → Teleport 1
Energy Shield 1 (prereq: Teleport, Chain Lightning)
Chain Lightning 20 → Lightning Mastery 20
Lightning · Charged Bolt (Chain Lightning synergies)

keyItems: Helm: Griffon's Eye (lowers enemy lightning resistance)
Weapon & shield: Spirit (sword and shield) or Heart of the Oak
Armor: Enigma or Skin of the Vipermagi
Gloves: Magefist
Belt: Arachnid Mesh
Ring: The Stone of Jordan
Mercenary: Act 2 mercenary + Infinity (Conviction aura breaks lightning immunity)
levelingNotes: Lightning immune monsters can only be killed with the Conviction aura from an Infinity mercenary — skip them until then.
Chain Lightning bounces between monsters, so fire it into the middle of a pack.
Hitting the 63% and 105% cast rate breakpoints makes a big difference.
strengths: Very fast kills where monsters are many (Terror Zones)
Teleport makes getting around quick
weaknesses: Weak against lightning immune monsters before an Infinity mercenary
Damage varies a lot, so single targets are inconsistent

title: Lightning Fury Amazon — javelin area damage
desc: A javelin Amazon that clears packs with Lightning Fury and bosses with Charged Strike
summary: A javelin Amazon who throws Lightning Fury to clear packs and kills melee bosses with Charged Strike. Lightning Fury gets stronger the more points you put into Charged Strike, Lightning Bolt, Power Strike and Lightning Strike.
statPriority: Strength only for gear requirements, Dexterity moderately for attack rating, the rest into Vitality.

skillOrder.skill: Hunt with Jab
Power Strike (prereq: Jab), Poison Javelin 1
Lightning Bolt 1 (prereq: Poison Javelin), Dodge · Avoid 1
Charged Strike (prereq: Power Strike, Lightning Bolt), Plague Javelin 1 (prereq: Lightning Bolt)
Lightning Fury 20 (prereq: Plague Javelin), Lightning Strike 1 (prereq: Charged Strike), Valkyrie 1 (prereq: Decoy, Evade)
Charged Strike 20 → Lightning Bolt · Power Strike · Lightning Strike (synergies)

keyItems: Weapon: Titan's Revenge or Thunderstroke (javelin)
Shield: Lidless Wall or Spirit
Helm: Griffon's Eye
Armor: Enigma or Chains of Honor
Belt: Arachnid Mesh
Mercenary: Act 2 mercenary + Infinity (breaks lightning immunity)
levelingNotes: Lightning Fury spreads lightning around the monster it hits — aim at the middle of a pack.
Charged Strike is a melee attack, so it is good for killing a single boss.
Skip lightning immune monsters if you don't have an Infinity mercenary.
strengths: Very fast pack clearing
Has attacks for both packs and bosses
weaknesses: Weak against lightning immune monsters before an Infinity mercenary
Heavily dependent on javelin gear (Titan's Revenge etc.)

title: Summoner Necromancer — staying safe with a skeleton army
desc: A summoner Necro that puts Skeleton Warriors, Skeletal Mages and Golems up front and cleans up with Corpse Explosion
summary: You summon Skeleton Warriors and Skeletal Mages to fight for you, while the Necromancer helps with curses and Corpse Explosion. Even with little gear, the skeletons take the hits for you, so leveling is safe.
statPriority: Strength only for gear requirements, Dexterity for blocking with a shield (optional), the rest into Vitality.

skillOrder.skill: Raise Skeleton · Skeleton Mastery, Amplify Damage 1
Clay Golem 1, Corpse Explosion 1 (prereq: Teeth)
Raise Skeletal Mage 1 (prereq: Raise Skeleton), Golem Mastery 1 (prereq: Clay Golem)
Summon Resist (prereq: Golem Mastery), Decrepify 1 (prereq: Weaken → Terror)
Raise Skeleton 20 → Skeleton Mastery 20 → Summon Resist, then Corpse Explosion if there is anything left

keyItems: Shield: Homunculus or Spirit
Helm: Harlequin Crest
Armor: Enigma or Skin of the Vipermagi
Weapon: Arm of King Leoric or a wand with +Summoning Skills
Mercenary: Act 2 mercenary + Insight
levelingNotes: Skeletons need corpses to be raised — keep refilling them from the monsters you kill.
Clear packs in one go with the Amplify Damage curse + Corpse Explosion.
Decrepify is good against bosses (slows them and reduces their damage).
strengths: The skeletons take the hits, so you stay safe
Can start with little gear
weaknesses: Kills are slower than elemental builds
In narrow paths the skeletons block the way

title: Smiter Paladin — Uber Tristram specialist
desc: A shield Paladin that kills Uber bosses with Smite, which always hits
summary: A single target Paladin who bashes with the shield using Smite (always hits) at high speed through the Fanaticism aura. It specializes in strong single targets such as Uber Tristram and Uber bosses rather than pack farming.
statPriority: Strength only for gear requirements, Dexterity only enough to reach max block with your shield, the rest into Vitality.

skillOrder.skill: Level with Sacrifice 1, Smite and Might
Charge 1 (prereq: Smite), hunt with Zeal (prereq: Sacrifice), Blessed Aim 1
Holy Bolt · Blessed Hammer 1 → Holy Shield 1 (prereq: Charge, Blessed Hammer)
Concentration 1 → Fanaticism 1 (prereq: Concentration)
Smite 20 → Fanaticism 20 → Holy Shield 20 → resist auras

keyItems: Weapon: Grief (Phase Blade etc.)
Shield: Herald of Zakarum
Helm: Guillaume's Face
Armor: Fortitude
Gloves: Dracul's Grasp
Ring: Raven Frost (cannot be frozen)
Mercenary: Act 2 mercenary + Insight or Infinity
levelingNotes: Smite always hits, so you don't have to worry about attack rating.
Against Uber Mephisto and Baal, cannot be frozen (Raven Frost) and resists are a must.
Pack hunting is slow, so share farming with other builds.
strengths: Very strong against strong single targets (always hits)
Holy Shield gives a high block chance, so you are sturdy
weaknesses: Slow at killing packs
Heavily dependent on gear such as Grief and Dracul's Grasp

title: Echoing Strike Warlock — two-handed weapon burst damage
desc: An Eldritch tree Warlock that throws echoes of a two-handed weapon to cut through packs and bosses alike
summary: An Eldritch tree build that sends out echoes of your weapon with Echoing Strike, piercing and cutting through packs. Echoing Strike uses weapon damage (90% since 3.2) and gets stronger the more points you put into Mirrored Blades and Blade Warp. You need Levitation Mastery to hold a two-handed weapon together with a Grimoire.
statPriority: Strength up to weapon requirements, Dexterity moderately for attack rating, the rest into Vitality.

skillOrder.skill: Levitation Mastery 1 (two-handed weapon + Grimoire)
Hunt with Cleave (prereq: Levitation Mastery)
Put points into Echoing Strike first (prereq: Levitation Mastery)
Blade Warp 1 (prereq: Echoing Strike, movement skill), Psychic Ward 1 (prereq: Cleave)
Eldritch Blast 1 (prereq: Mind Ward)
Mirrored Blades 1 (prereq: Blade Warp, Eldritch Blast), Echoing Strike 20
Mirrored Blades · Blade Warp 20 (synergies) → Levitation Mastery

keyItems: Weapon: a two-handed weapon with high base damage
Offhand: Grimoire (required to hold a two-handed weapon in one hand, 3.2)
Armor: Enigma or Chains of Honor
Helm: Harlequin Crest
Belt: Arachnid Mesh
Mercenary: Act 2 mercenary + Insight
levelingNotes: Since 3.2, to hold a two-handed weapon in one hand you need a Grimoire in the other hand (a shield won't do).
Blade Warp is your main movement skill until you get Enigma (Teleport).
It uses weapon damage as is, so your damage changes a lot every time you swap weapons.
strengths: Very high damage against both packs and bosses
Blade Warp makes getting around fast
weaknesses: Heavily weapon dependent
Busy to play

title: Fire Warlock — the fastest leveling
desc: A Chaos tree Warlock that pushes through Normal and Nightmare fast with Ring of Fire and Flame Wave
summary: A Chaos tree fire build that sweeps the way ahead with Flame Wave and burns everything around you with Ring of Fire. Flame Wave gets stronger the more points you put into Ring of Fire and Apocalypse, and you add Apocalypse from level 30. Damage was reduced in 3.2, but leveling speed is still fast.
statPriority: Strength only for gear requirements, the rest into Vitality.

skillOrder.skill: Hunt with Miasma Bolt
Ring of Fire (no prereq), Sigil: Lethargy 1
Put points into Flame Wave first (prereq: Ring of Fire), Sigil: Rancor 1 (prereq: Sigil: Lethargy)
Sigil: Death 1 (prereq: Sigil: Rancor)
Apocalypse (prereq: Flame Wave, Sigil: Death)
Flame Wave 20 → Ring of Fire · Apocalypse (synergies)

keyItems: Weapon: Spirit or Heart of the Oak (faster cast rate, all skills)
Offhand: Grimoire
Helm: Harlequin Crest
Armor: Enigma or Skin of the Vipermagi
Gloves: Magefist
Belt: Arachnid Mesh
Mercenary: Act 2 mercenary + Infinity (Conviction aura breaks fire immunity)
levelingNotes: Normal and Nightmare are fast enough with Flame Wave alone.
In Hell, fire immune monsters can only be killed with an Infinity mercenary.
Hitting the 75% and 125% cast rate breakpoints makes a big difference (same table as the Necromancer).
strengths: Very fast leveling
Can start with little gear
weaknesses: Weak against fire immune monsters in Hell
The 3.2 nerf leaves late game damage lower than other builds
